figures.caption: 25-year NTR-gap event study. Top: national context (China import share vs US mfg/pop). A: C1 manufacturing jobs / working-age pop, θ_t per IQR with 95% CI — flat before 2001, sharp post-accession divergence, no recovery through 2023; markers at PNTR (2000-10), accession (2001-12), 2018–19 tariff war; open markers = contaminated jobs-denominator 1998/99 anchors. B: C2 unemployment rate (1990–2024, the flat load-bearing pre-trend) and non-participation proxy.
figures.alt: Three stacked panels; national context strip on top, then two event-study line plots with confidence bands showing a flat pre-2001 segment and a widening negative manufacturing effect that plateaus without recovering through 2023.

figures.caption: Both identifications agree the manufacturing hit is permanent. Left: Arm A reduced-form C1 θ_t per IQR of NTR gap, 2019 (-1.46) and 2023 (-1.49) highlighted. Right: Arm B 2SLS on accumulated 2000–2012 ΔIPW (other-hi instrument) reproducing 002's -0.432 dashed line, alongside A4 (ΔIPW instrumented by NTR gap, descriptive bridge only).
figures.alt: Two panels: a line plot of the reduced-form manufacturing effect stable from 2019 to 2023, and a bar chart of 2SLS long-difference coefficients for both arms landing on the -0.432 reference line.

notes: Arm A is the Pierce–Schott tariff-uncertainty (PNTR) shock transplanted into the ADH commuting-zone frame — NOT a re-estimate of ADH's realized-import estimand; per-IQR NTR-gap units are not comparable to per-$1k ΔIPW.
Annual LAUS 1990–2024 was re-fetched from FRED (only fetch made): 001's staged checkpoint held only 5 snapshot years, but the C2 1990s pre-trend is load-bearing.
C2 pre-2000 uses the LAUS unemployment rate (popest 15–64 starts 2000); C1 1998/99 anchors are jobs-denominator and contaminated (supporting-only, not a test).

A4 not headlined: the Sec-4 variant rejects its exclusion restriction, so it is a descriptive bridge, not causal 2SLS. C4 terminal 2022; C3 snapshots only. Proxy outcomes (CBP/LAUS/QCEW/BEA) inherited from 001.

Pre-trend flatness is conditional on the full-control spec; the lean sensitivity spec's C2 pre-2000 coefficients load significantly (see findings.md disclosure). PNTR anticipation in 1999-2000 biases post-2001 estimates conservatively toward zero.
